# opnsense_haproxy_action (Resource)

HAProxy rules (**Services ▸ HAProxy ▸ Settings ▸ Rules & Checks ▸ Rules**, plugin `os-haproxy`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_haproxy_action" "api" {
  name        = "api"
  type        = "use_backend"
  linked_acls = [opnsense_haproxy_acl.api_host.id]
  use_backend = opnsense_haproxy_backend.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name to identify this rule.
- `type` (String) Choose a HAProxy action that should be used if the condition evaluates to true. One of `compression`, `fcgi_pass_header`, `fcgi_set_param`, `http-after-response`, `http-request`, `http-response`, `map_data_use_backend`, `map_use_backend`, `monitor_fail`, `tcp-request`, `tcp-response`, `use_backend`, `use_server`, `custom`.

### Optional

- `compression_algo_req` (String) The compression algorithm used for HTTP requests. Compression will only be used depending on the Accept-Encoding request header. One of `gzip`, `deflate`, `raw-deflate`. Defaults to `gzip`.
- `compression_algo_res` (String) The compression algorithm used for HTTP responses. Compression will only be used depending on the Accept-Encoding request header. One of `gzip`, `deflate`, `raw-deflate`. Defaults to `gzip`.
- `compression_direction` (String) Whether HAProxy uses compression for HTTP responses, HTTP requests, or both. Be aware that most servers will not support request body decompression. For safekeeping only enable compression for HTTP responses. One of `response`, `request`, `both`. Defaults to `response`.
- `compression_mime_req` (Set of String) HTTP requests will use compression for the specified mime types, i.e. text/css, text/html, application/javascript. Defaults to `[]`.
- `compression_mime_res` (Set of String) HTTP responses will use compression for the specified mime types, i.e. text/css, text/html, application/javascript. Defaults to `[]`.
- `compression_minsize_req` (Number) Specifies a minimum file size for HTTP request compression in bytes. By avoiding unnecessary compression work on very small files, this may reduce CPU overhead. Entering 0 disables this option. Defaults to `1500`.
- `compression_minsize_res` (Number) Specifies a minimum file size for HTTP response compression in bytes. By avoiding unnecessary compression work on very small files, this may reduce CPU overhead. Entering 0 disables this option. Defaults to `1500`.
- `compression_offloading` (Boolean) When enabled, the load balancer will remove the Accept-Encoding header before forwarding a request to backend servers. This prevents the servers from performing compression, offloading that work to the load balancer. This may impact HAProxy's performance. Defaults to `false`.
- `custom` (String) Specify a HAProxy rule/ACL that is currently not supported by the GUI. Defaults to ``.
- `description` (String) Description for this rule. Defaults to ``.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this rule. Defaults to `true`.
- `fcgi_pass_header` (String) Specify the name of a request header which will be passed to the FastCGI application. Most request headers are already available to the FastCGI application, prefixed with "HTTP_". Thus, this directive is only required to pass headers that are purposefully omitted. Currently, the headers "Authorization", "Proxy-Authorization" and hop-by-hop headers are omitted. Defaults to ``.
- `fcgi_set_param` (String) Set a FastCGI parameter that should be passed to the application. Its value must follow HAProxy's Custom Log format rules. With this directive, it is possible to overwrite the value of default FastCGI parameters. Defaults to ``.
- `gpc_number` (Number) Refers to the number of the General Purpose Counter, e.g. 0 or 1 when using gpc0 or gpc1 respectively. This value will be ignored in rules that do not support GPC. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `gpt_number` (Number) Refers to the number of the General Purpose Tag, e.g. 0 or 1 when using gpt0 or gpt1 respectively. This value will be ignored in rules that do not support GPT. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
